nBootstrap: Nonparametric Bootstrap Confidence Intervals

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

2026-11-28 05:56:18

Source: vignettes/nBootstrap.Rmd
nBootstrap.Rmd

Description

Nonparametric bootstrap helpers in R (R Core Team, 2026): percentile, bias-corrected, and bias-corrected and accelerated confidence intervals from a matrix of draws, and nonparametric bootstrap and jackknife half-vectorized covariance matrices computed in C++. The functions are internal; other projects copy them.

Installation

You can install the development version of nBootstrap from GitHub with:

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/nBootstrap")

Example

The functions are internal.

set.seed(seed = 42)
x <- as.matrix(x = datasets::mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt")])

Bootstrap draws of the half-vectorized covariance matrix.

draws <- nBootstrap:::.NBVechCovDraws(x = x, R = 1000L)
dim(x = draws)
#> [1] 1000    3

Percentile confidence intervals for every column of the draws.

theta_hat <- c(stats::cov(x = x))[c(1, 2, 4)]
names(x = theta_hat) <- c("var_mpg", "cov", "var_wt")
colnames(x = draws) <- names(x = theta_hat)
nBootstrap:::.CIMat(
  thetahatstar = draws,
  thetahat = theta_hat,
  alpha = c(0.05, 0.01),
  type = "pc"
)
#>               est        se    R       0.5%       2.5%     97.5%     99.5%
#> var_mpg 36.324103 8.2878501 1000 15.6449379 20.4642755 52.335445 56.567037
#> cov     -5.116685 1.1974755 1000 -8.1858457 -7.5797050 -2.761651 -2.235399
#> var_wt   0.957379 0.2412427 1000  0.4045389  0.4841965  1.418687  1.597035
